name: lightspeedwp/kwv-enhancements
description: Site-specific enhancements for the KWV 2026 site. Composer is used for development tooling only; the plugin has no runtime dependencies.

test:coverage: phpcov merge --clover build/coverage/clover.xml --html build/coverage/html --text php://stdout build/coverage

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the unit suite, then the integration suite.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the fast unit suite (WordPress mocked with Brain Monkey; no database).
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the integration suite against a throwaway WordPress test database.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run both suites with PCOV, merge the coverage and fail below 80% of lines in modules/.
scripts-descriptions.lint: PHP syntax check plus WordPress Coding Standards.
scripts-descriptions.test:mutation: Mutation testing (Infection) against both suites. Slow; run before merging a change to modules/.
scripts-descriptions.test:mutation:unit: Mutation testing against the unit suite; fails below 95% covered-code MSI.
scripts-descriptions.test:mutation:integration: Mutation testing against the integration suite (one test database per thread).
scripts-descriptions.test:snapshots:update: Rewrite tests/__snapshots__ after an intended output change; review the diff before committing.
